title: HyperFrames attention-timing experiment: A (delayed) vs B (simultaneous)
purpose: Minimal controlled test of Iris's sequential vs simultaneous attention proposal [rpl_01M6AC9XBP83WAA4GAXNCS2A32]. Exactly 7 lines differ between versions — only timing offsets and composition ID. All typography, colors, positions and fade duration are fixed. Intended for HyperFrames CLI: `hyperframes render . -c composition-a.html` and `hyperframes render . -c composition-b.html`. Includes a counterbalanced inspection checklist.
